sql.ahj.inspection.detailByAhj: SELECT i.*, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(contacts))) FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.title, c.email, c.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", c.address, c.notes, c.hours, act.id AS "contactTypeId" FROM brs.ahj_contact c INNER JOIN brs.ahj_inspection_contact aic ON c.id = aic.ahj_contact_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_contact_type act ON act.id = c.contact_type_id WHERE aic.ahj_inspection_id = i.id AND c.archived IS FALSE AND c.contact_type_id = 9) contacts), '[]') AS utility_service_dept_contacts, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(contacts))) FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.title, c.email, c.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", c.address, c.notes, c.hours FROM brs.ahj_contact c INNER JOIN brs.ahj_inspection_contact aic ON c.id = aic.ahj_contact_id WHERE aic.ahj_inspection_id = i.id AND c.archived IS FALSE AND c.contact_type_id = 2) contacts), '[]') AS scheduling_contacts, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(contacts))) FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.title, c.email, c.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", c.address, c.notes, c.hours FROM brs.ahj_contact c INNER JOIN brs.ahj_inspection_contact aic ON c.id = aic.ahj_contact_id WHERE aic.ahj_inspection_id = i.id AND c.archived IS FALSE AND c.contact_type_id = 3) contacts), '[]') AS obtaining_results_contacts, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(contacts))) FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.title, c.email, c.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", c.address, c.notes, c.hours FROM brs.ahj_contact c INNER JOIN brs.ahj_inspection_contact aic ON c.id = aic.ahj_contact_id WHERE aic.ahj_inspection_id = i.id AND c.archived IS FALSE AND c.contact_type_id = 4) contacts), '[]') AS fee_contacts, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder", ac.failed_inspection_date AS "failedInspectionDate", ac.failed_inspection_resource_id AS "failedInspectionResourceId", ac.failed_inspection_project AS "failedInspectionProject", o.org_name AS "resource" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_inspection_checklist aic ON ac.id = aic.ahj_checklist_id INNER JOIN flow.org o ON o.id = ac.failed_inspection_resource_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND aic.ahj_inspection_id = i.id AND ac.checklist_type_id = 8 ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]') AS failureChecklist, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_inspection_checklist aic ON ac.id = aic.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND aic.ahj_inspection_id = i.id AND ac.checklist_type_id = 9 ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]') AS schedulingChecklist, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_inspection_checklist aic ON ac.id = aic.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND aic.ahj_inspection_id = i.id AND ac.checklist_type_id = 10 ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]') AS obtainingResultsChecklist, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_inspection_checklist aic ON ac.id = aic.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND aic.ahj_inspection_id = i.id AND ac.checklist_type_id = 11 ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]') AS reinspectionsChecklist, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_inspection_checklist aic ON ac.id = aic.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND aic.ahj_inspection_id = i.id AND ac.checklist_type_id = 12 ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]') AS schedulingWithAhjChecklist, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_inspection_checklist aic ON ac.id = aic.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND aic.ahj_inspection_id = i.id AND ac.checklist_type_id = 13 ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]') AS schedulingWithBrsTechnicianChecklist, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(requirements))) FROM ( WITH open_challenge AS ( SELECT ahj_id, original_requirement_id, status_id FROM brs.ahj_requirements ar WHERE status_id = 3 ) SELECT ar.ahj_id AS "ahjId", ar.position, ar.status_id AS "statusId", ars.name status, ar.complete, ar.date_created AS "dateCreated", ar.created_by_id AS "createdById", u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS "createdBy", ar.date_updated AS "dateUpdated", ar.updated_by_id AS "updatedById", ar.archived, u2.first_name || ' ' || u2.last_name AS "updatedBy", r.id, r.description, r.requirement_type_id AS "requirementTypeId", ar.original_requirement_id AS "originalRequirementId", art.name AS "requirementType", CASE WHEN oc.original_requirement_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS "hasOpenChallenge" FROM brs.ahj_requirements ar LEFT JOIN open_challenge oc ON oc.ahj_id = ar.ahj_id AND oc.original_requirement_id = ar.original_requirement_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement r ON r.id = ar.requirement_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement_type art ON art.id = r.requirement_type_id INNER JOIN flow."user" u ON u.id = ar.created_by_id INNER JOIN flow."user" u2 ON u2.id = ar.updated_by_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement_status ars ON ars.id = ar.status_id WHERE ar.ahj_id = i.ahj_id AND art.id = 5 AND ar.status_id = 1 AND ar.archived IS NOT TRUE ORDER BY ar.position) requirements), '[]') AS installationRequirements, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT apl.id, apl.name, apl.link, apl.username, apl.link_type_id AS "linkTypeId", apl.password, apl.notes FROM brs.ahj_inspection_link apl WHERE apl.archived IS FALSE AND apl.link_type_id = 1 AND apl.ahj_inspection_id = i.id) links ), '[]') AS schedulingLinks, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT apl.id, apl.name, apl.link, apl.username, apl.link_type_id AS "linkTypeId", apl.password, apl.notes FROM brs.ahj_inspection_link apl WHERE apl.archived IS FALSE AND apl.link_type_id = 2 AND apl.ahj_inspection_id = i.id) links ), '[]') AS fotLinks, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT apl.id, apl.name, apl.link, apl.username, apl.link_type_id AS "linkTypeId", apl.password, apl.notes FROM brs.ahj_inspection_link apl WHERE apl.archived IS FALSE AND apl.link_type_id = 3 AND apl.ahj_inspection_id = i.id) links ), '[]') AS resultsLinks, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(fots))) FROM ( SELECT u.id, u.first_name AS "firstName", u.last_name AS "lastName", u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS "fullName", o.org_name AS office, o.id AS "officeId" FROM flow."user" u INNER JOIN flow.user_position up ON up.user_id = u.id and ((now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date ) BETWEEN up.start_date::date and coalesce(up.end_date::date, (now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date ) INNER JOIN flow.org o ON o.id = up.org_id LEFT JOIN brs.org_metro_area oma ON oma.org_id = o.id LEFT JOIN brs.ahj ON ahj.metro_area_id = oma.metro_area_id WHERE o.org_type_id = 8 AND ahj.id = i.ahj_id) fots ), '[]') AS servicingFots, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(noteTemplates))) FROM ( SELECT n.id, n.title, n.note FROM brs.ahj_base_note_template n INNER JOIN brs.ahj_inspection_base_note bn ON n.id = bn.ahj_base_note_template_id WHERE bn.ahj_inspection_id = i.id AND n.archived IS FALSE ) AS noteTemplates ), '[]') AS baseNoteTemplates FROM brs.ahj_inspection i WHERE i.ahj_id = :ahjId
sql.ahj.inspection.update:

homeowner_required = :homeownerRequired, brs_tech_required = :brsTechRequired,

inspection_time_window = :inspectionTimeWindow, brs_inspection_rep = :brsInspectionRep, portal_url = :portalUrl, portal_username = :portalUsername, portal_password = :portalPassword, obtaining_results_method = :obtainingResultsMethod, approval_document_method = :approvalDocumentMethod, obtaining_results_portal_url = :obtainingResultsPortalUrl, obtaining_results_portal_username = :obtainingResultsPortalUsername, obtaining_results_portal_password = :obtainingResultsPortalPassword, business_license = :businessLicense, contractor_license = :contractorLicense, homeowner_required_on_site = :homeownerRequiredOnSite, fall_protection_required = :fallProtectionRequired, call_for_time_window = :callForTimeWindow, ladder_required = :ladderRequired, time_window = :timeWindow, time_window_call_time = :timeWindowCallTime, time_window_phone = :timeWindowPhone, updated = now(), updated_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
